title: Correct Height Calculation
description: Essential Criteria - The height of the stationary orbit must be correctly calculated as h = 3.59 x 10^4 km.

title: Correct Receptor Size
description: Essential Criteria - The required size of the ground receptor station must be correctly estimated as 3.59 x 10^4 m.

title: Use of Relevant Equations
description: Important Criteria - The student should correctly apply the gravitational force and angular velocity equations to derive the height.

title: Diffraction Consideration
description: Important Criteria - The student should consider diffraction effects when estimating the receptor size.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria - The student should maintain consistent units throughout the calculations.

title: Common Calculation Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria - The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of constants.

title: Final Answer Format
description: Optional Criteria - The final answers should be presented in a clear and correct format.
